Fixed code-defect: handleAddToCart was returning stripped-down [{productId, price, quantity}] instead of the original [{product, variant, quantity}] objects, causing AddToCartModal to crash with "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'imageGroups')". Fix committed. However, the E2E test still fails on its console-error budget assertion because the add-to-cart flow triggers Einstein/sandbox API 400/403 errors not included in the test's BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS. The functional assertions (modal close, confirmation modal, product-added row) all pass.
